from.place: Proof, sole paragraph: "at every finite stage it is an isomorphism by [thm-weil-pbc-finite-extension]"; subordinate pro-etale coefficient-continuity tool reached through prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-basechange-compatibility, bounded-below coproducts, affine acyclic hypercovers, and qc affine contractible covers. The blueprint paragraph itself does not mention hypercovers. Input: bounded ring witness from 0983/0984. Supporting input: Geometric sufficient criterion for all weakly etale covers to split.

title: Geometric sufficient criterion for all weakly etale covers to split
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring such that $\operatorname{Spec}R$ is w-local [def-weil-pbc-w-local], the quotient space $\pi_0(\operatorname{Spec}R)$ of connected components is extremally disconnected (the closure of every open subset is open), and $R_{\mathfrak m}$ is strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ of $R$. Then for every commutative ring $B$ and every faithfully flat weakly etale ring map $f:R\to B$ [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], there is a ring map $r:B\to R$ satisfying $r\circ f=\mathrm{id}_R$.
